prompt: The image is rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash style. In the center stands a wooden stall piled high with bright orange pumpkins. To the left of the stall, an old woman in a blue shawl sits on a low stool, her back slightly hunched. Next to her, a small boy in a striped shirt points eagerly at a large pumpkin on the pile. The old woman looks at the boy with a gentle expression. Behind them, a tall man in a grey coat leans against a stone wall, watching the scene unfold. A brown dog sleeps peacefully at the feet of the tall man, its tail curled around its nose. On the right side of the frame, a vendor in a white apron hands a woven basket to a young girl in a yellow dress. The young girl reaches out with both hands to accept the basket. Beside the vendor, a black cat perches on a crate of apples, grooming its paw. Above the stall, a rooster with red comb crows from a wooden beam. Near the rooster, a hanging lantern sways gently in the morning breeze. In the foreground, a stray goat with curved horns nibbles on a discarded cabbage leaf. Next to the goat, a broken clay pot lies on its side. A fishmonger in rubber boots stands near the edge of the frame, holding a silver fish up for inspection. A customer in a green hat looks at the fish with interest. There is no electricity or modern signage visible in the scene. There is no rain or wet pavement depicted in the market square.
